mood: proud, protective and a little bit in awe (they're SO big)
thought: Rusty just strutted at a pine cone, and honestly, good for him.
today: Day 13: I found a flock of wild turkeys in my east field, my cousins! I built the Roost, a big bare oak they sleep in, and they fly down at dawn, walk to the acorn oak, scratch, strut and fly back up at sunset on the real clock.
